other_conditions: Orthopedic physically handicapped person with a permanent disability of 40% or more
Applicant may be the driver or not
Car length must be less than or equal to 4 metres
Engine capacity must not exceed 1200 cc for petrol/LPG/CNG cars or 1500 cc for diesel cars
Certificate is valid for six months from the date of issuance
Vehicle must be purchased within three months of certificate issuance
Applicant must inform the Department of Heavy Industry of the purchase and provide the vehicle registration number within 30 days of registration
benefits_summary: A 10% GST concession (paying 18% GST instead of 28%) and zero cess on eligible car purchases.
